summary: A tentative proposal for a Unified User Level Protocol, intended to prompt discussion rather than serve as a rigorous specification. The author argues that using a different contact socket for each service, as FTP and RJE do, was unfortunate and unnecessary. He suggests a single approach built on Telnet.

eli5.summary: Instead of a different front door for every service, one author suggests using the same door and then saying what you want once inside.

questions: telnet as base for ftp proposal
